reviewer: Independent regulation_contacts build subagent; manual input-and-answer-key semantic review
scope: Independent review of actual provider explanations for ten synthetic minimal English deduction inputs. This is explanation quality, not classification accuracy or legal/medical adjudication. Reviewer made no provider API calls.
criteria: Amounts and their association with the correct item/calculation are faithful to input.
Missing-clause insurer assertions are not stated as independently confirmed coverage facts.
No invented policy term, validity decision, legal breach or clinical-necessity assessment.
Insurer settlement payment is not confused with the patient’s payment obligation.
Coherent explanation of at most 100 whitespace-delimited words; no requirement to reproduce the full legal answer key.

cases.review_note: Correct ₹8,000 deduction, 20% ratio and ₹6,000/₹4,800 room amounts. The room-rent justification stays attributed to the insurer; no missing policy clause is treated as confirmed.

Correct ₹1,500 total and ₹550/₹400/₹550 item amounts. Excluded/non-medical terms remain insurer labels. No clinical determination or coverage conclusion; insurer-payment direction is correct. The intermediate unsupported clinical definition is absent.

Correct ₹54,500−₹50,000=₹4,500 per-eye benefit-cap arithmetic. Supplied DEMO clause and no prior use are identified; explanation stays within the fixture-provided cap and does not introduce a different policy term.
Correct ₹72,500×20%=₹14,500 and ₹58,000 insurer balance. Supplied co-payment clause is attributed with explicit limits on independent applicability confirmation.
Correct ₹32,000−₹20,000=₹12,000. Reports the insurer’s reasonable-and-customary basis, missing comparison data and unconfirmed policy applicability; no declaration of lawfulness or unlawfulness.
Correct ₹2,400 disputed tape/gauze deduction. Preserves insurer package-inclusion allegation and hospital’s contrary position; neither coverage nor medical merit is independently decided.
Correct ₹3,100 tests and ankle-admission context. Unrelatedness is the insurer’s allegation, while the treating doctor’s order is preserved. No diagnosis or unsupported necessity judgment.
Correct ₹3,250 claim reduction. Generic terms and absent item/clause remain unexplained; no substitute deduction category is invented and payment direction is not reversed.

Misassigns ₹62,500 to the approved room-rent charge. Input gives no room-rent amount; ₹62,500 is only the separate co-payment calculation base. Correct 20%/₹12,500 arithmetic and a missing-clause caveat do not cure this item/amount association error.

Correct attributed ₹50,000 maternity ceiling, ₹30,000 prior use, ₹20,000 remainder, ₹42,000 bill and ₹22,000 deduction. Explicitly leaves rule applicability unconfirmed because the policy clause is missing.

baseline.note: Earlier root-reviewed baseline retained separately; this reviewer did not overwrite its decisions.

limitations: Ten synthetic English inputs do not establish accuracy on real settlement documents, OCR errors, Hindi explanations or all policy variants.
The provider does not classify category or validity. Deterministic 15/15 fixture results must be reported separately.
Per-case input/explanation hashes bind this review to exact text; any later provider rerun requires a new review.
followup: Correct S09 item/amount association: room rent is approved with amount unspecified; the stated co-pay base is ₹62,500. Retain this failure if a revised prompt is tested.
